## What’s new in FielDHub 1.7.0

FielDHub adds augmented row-column designs, block-based plot numbering for augmented RCBD, and faster allocation for sparse and multi-location partially replicated trials. Partially replicated designs also gain the option to keep replicated entries in distinct rows and columns.

<span id="usage"></span>

## Install and launch

Install the released R package from CRAN.

```r
install.packages("FielDHub")
```

Launch the Shiny app from R. You can also call the design functions directly from a script.

```r
FielDHub::run_app()
```

## Experimental designs

Use the same four groups in the Shiny app to find the 21 design workflows.
